steps.title: Battery latch
steps.helper: Tap the battery, check the charge, then slide the latch until it clicks.
steps.hint: An unlatched battery can shift or eject in flight, which means total power loss and a crash.

steps.title: Propellers
steps.helper: Tap the glowing rotor. Move in close and look for chips, cracks or bends.
steps.hint: A cracked blade can shed at high RPM. Vibration and imbalance are a leading cause of small-UAS crashes.

steps.title: Gimbal clamp
steps.helper: Swipe up on the clear clamp to slide it off the camera.
steps.hint: If the clamp is still fitted at power-up, the gimbal motors strain against it and the self-test fails.

steps.title: Controller calibration
steps.helper: Tap CALIBRATE RC, then centre, rotate both sticks fully, and centre again.
steps.hint: An uncalibrated controller can cause drift or unintended inputs at take-off.
